// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the issue.
Origin* (xref:#entidad-observed-source[ObservedSource])::
Origin whose errors are grouped in the issue.
Fingerprint* (string)::
Hash of the exception type and the first in-app frames without line numbers (or of the normalized message); unique per source.
Title* (string)::
Exception type and normalized message.
Culprit (string)::
Function or file of the first in-app frame.
Kind* (ObservedIssueKindOptions)::
ERROR: errors grouped by fingerprint. PERFORMANCE: performance problems detected in the traces (N+1 queries, slow operations).Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * ERROR
 * PERFORMANCE

Level* (ObservedIssueLevelOptions)::
Level of the grouped events.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * warning
 * error
 * fatal

Status* (ObservedIssueStatusOptions)::
Triage state: UNRESOLVED, RESOLVED (closed until it is seen again, then it reopens as a regression), IGNORED or MERGED (its events count in merged-into).Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * UNRESOLVED
 * RESOLVED
 * IGNORED
 * MERGED

Merged into (string)::
Uid of the issue this one was merged into; its fingerprint is an alias of that issue.
Assignee (string)::
Who takes care of the issue (the user of the viewer that assigned it).
Assignee name (string)::
Name of the assignee, as the viewer shows it.
Ignore until (datetime)::
An IGNORED issue reopens after this moment (empty: ignored for ever, or by count).
Ignore until count (integer)::
An IGNORED issue reopens when its count reaches this value (empty: ignored for ever, or by date).
Tracker url (string)::
Task of the issue in the issue tracker (Redmine, Jira...).
First seen at (datetime)::
When the first event of the issue arrived.
Last seen at (datetime)::
When the last event of the issue arrived.
Count* (integer)::
Number of events grouped in the issue.
Last event id (string)::
Identifier of the last raw event in the store, to open it.
Last trace id (string)::
Trace of the last event, to open it in the viewer.
Users* (integer)::
Approximate number of distinct users (or browser sessions, when the event has no user) that suffered the issue.
Tenants* (integer)::
Approximate number of distinct tenants where the issue was seen.
Users sketch (blob)::
HyperLogLog sketch of the pseudonymized users, to keep counting without storing them (base64; not reversible).
Tenants sketch (blob)::
HyperLogLog sketch of the pseudonymized tenants (base64; not reversible).
First release (string)::
Version of the origin where the issue was seen for the first time.
Release (string)::
Last version of the origin where the issue was seen. A RESOLVED issue reopens only when it is seen again in a later version (resolved in the next release).
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de observed issue para controlar bloqueos optimistas
